Type.description: Represents a top-level struct data definition declared in the document.

name.description: Unique name of the type definition (e.g., 'User', 'Product', 'ErrorResponse').

type.description: Kind of top-level type structure. Must be strictly set to 'struct'.

description.description: Plain text documentation explaining the usage and purpose of this struct.

deprecated.description: Indicates whether this type is deprecated. Set to true to flag as deprecated; defaults to false.

parent.description: Target type name if this struct inherits properties from a parent struct type. Omit if there is no inheritance.

properties.description: List of property fields defined on this struct.

Type_Property.description: Represents an individual property field inside a top-level struct definition.

description.description: Plain text description of the property field.

deprecated.description: Indicates whether this field is deprecated. Defaults to false if omitted.

nullable.description: Indicates whether this property value can be null. Defaults to false if omitted.

type.description: Data type of this property. Must be strictly one of: 'string', 'integer', 'number', 'boolean', 'object', 'map', 'array', or 'any'. When set to 'object', 'map', or 'array', the 'reference' property must also be set.

reference.description: Target type name referenced by this property. Required when 'type' is set to 'object' (referenced struct), 'map' (value type), or 'array' (element type). Omit for primitive types.

Document.description: Root document structure representing the complete API specification state.

types.description: Array of all top-level type definitions declared in this specification.

root.description: Zero-based index referencing the primary entry point type within the 'types' array.
